source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 июля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Вианора и Силуана (IV).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry, first name, and this folder’s man: the same menologion day its Romanian and Greek rows already keep, the same Pisidia the folder’s own byname carries — name page 411 heads him «Вианор Писидийский, мч.» and lists «День памяти: 10 июля» and no other day. THE READING life4211 WAS OPENED and is the pair’s: Bianor came from the region of Pisidia in Asia Minor and was brought as a confessor to the governor of the city of Isauria in Lycaonia, who pressed him to deny Christ; he stood firm through elaborate torments, and a man named Silvanus who was watching was given faith by his patience and courage, declared it openly, had his tongue cut out and his head struck off on the spot, and Bianor after long torments was beheaded too. `dates` STILL NULL AND DELIBERATELY SO: the line gives «(IV)» and the reading says outright «Время страданий … точно не известно; предполагают, что они скончались при римском императоре Диоклетиане (284–305)» — the time is not exactly known and it is SUPPOSED that they died under Diocletian. A supposition the source marks as one is not a date, and the century on the line does not agree with it either; nothing was written and the question is in the report. `types` UNCHANGED. TWO ENTRIES OF THIS DAY WERE WITHHELD AND ARE NAMED IN THE REPORT, both folders already carrying a VENERATED russian row on another Julian day: `anthony-of-the-caves` on 2 сентября (three hymns on this page left uncopied) and `silouan-of-the-kyiv-caves` on 10 июня — whose own row-note already records that his name page lists 10 июля as a day it did not read, and whose two hymns were taken there. BRIEF-RUSSIAN §4 forbids a draft on such a folder and BRIEF.md §4 sanctions a second-day note; the author has not ruled, so nothing was written for either. LEFT OUT of this day: «Положение честной ризы Господа нашего Иисуса Христа в Москве (1625)», the laying up of the Lord’s robe, which is a feast and not a person, with its troparion, kontakion and величание; and the Konevskaya icon with its two hymns.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Vianor»

attestations.note: The day prints the two men on separate lines and both link to one short page, «Sfinții Mucenici Vianor și Siluan», so the corpus keeps one folder for each.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Βιάνωρ και Σιλουανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is plainly the same man: «Ο Άγιος Βιάνωρ καταγόταν από την επαρχία της Πισιδίας», the province the folder's own byname keeps him by, and the Greek line pairs him with Silvanus as the Romanian one does. He is the corpus's only Bianor. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under their line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
